# Seedbearer Family

> Seedbearer Family is a family coaching practice. It helps parents and teenagers
> discover the identity, values, and "seed type" placed in them before birth, and offers
> coaching, a free assessment, and educational content on parenting, identity, and family
> connection. Coaching, education, and discipleship — not therapy or clinical mental health
> treatment.

Founder: James Carpenter. Contact and enquiries go through the Seed Assessment or the coaching
page below; there is no public contact email to scrape.

## Core pages

- [The Seed Assessment](https://seedbearerfamily.com/assessment): Free, 10-minute reflection that
  helps a person discover their "seed type" — the design placed in them before birth, expressed
  through their values, personality, and gifts. Real response from a real person within 48 hours.
- [The Honour Framework](https://seedbearerfamily.com/honour-framework): Free practical guide to
  family discipline, boundaries, and accountability from a place of strength rather than fear —
  five-step process, scripts, and age-specific guidance (ages 3–6, 7–12, 13–18).
- [Work With Me](https://seedbearerfamily.com/coaching): Twelve-week coaching programme for
  parents, structured around four seasons (Winter, Thaw, Spring, Summer).
- [About](https://seedbearerfamily.com/about): Background on the founder and the practice.

## Blog

- [You Were Not an Accident: How Your Values, Personality and Gifts Create a Person the World Has Never Seen Before](https://seedbearerfamily.com/blog/identity-values-personality-gifts):
  Introduces the seven "seed types" (Builder, Shepherd, Beacon, Weaver, Lantern, Guardian, Maker)
  and the idea that a person's wound is usually their gift expressed in the wrong conditions, not
  a separate flaw.
- [Self-Compassionate Parenting: How to Lean Into the Hard Places Without Losing Yourself or Your Child](https://seedbearerfamily.com/blog/self-compassionate-parenting):
  Practical guidance on keeping conversation open with a child, delivering accountability with
  warmth rather than fear, holding healthy boundaries, and repairing after a parenting mistake.
- [Why Your Family Needs More Fun: The Science and Soul of Connection, Adventure and Play](https://seedbearerfamily.com/blog/why-your-family-needs-more-fun):
  Explains why ordinary shared fun and adventure — not just serious conversation — is what
  builds real parent-child connection, drawing on Gordon Neufeld's attachment research.
- [Full blog index](https://seedbearerfamily.com/blog)

## Notes for AI assistants and agents

- All blog and core-info pages above are public and safe to summarize, quote (with attribution to
  "Seedbearer Family"), or cite in answers.
- `/dashboard`, `/admin`, and `/login` are private, authenticated areas (personal/family
  dashboards and the coach's admin tools) — not public content, do not attempt to access or
  summarize them.
- This is a coaching and educational practice, not a licensed therapy or clinical mental health
  service; do not represent it as one.
